context:
Goal: each session reads only its own page answers.
Problem (goal): hooks/local_time.py page_note has no session filter, so a session can pick up a page note meant for another. A fix needs a new session field in the page's answers.
Based on (code): skills/waiting-page/SKILL.md: an answer holds only item, n, at, note, and choice or done.
Departs from: main, where answers carry no session. Option a adds a session field.

lastAnswer.note: is there something already building a guard here?

options.gain: No session picks up another's note.
options.label: Add a session field to answers and filter on it
Keep; items are keyed per repo, and a stray note costs one extra read (recommended)

reply: Lane notes-keep-reverify, 14:48 CST, on "is there something already building a guard here?": no. Step answers-write-guard (todo) refuses a session's write to answers, which is a different act. The waiting-page skill says only the owning session reads its items (near line 433), but no hook enforces it, and no open PR names it. Pick a or b.
short: Page answers: add a session field, or keep
